name: Popularity
overview: Scripture warns believers about the dangers of seeking popularity and the approval of others, as seen in Luke 6:26 where Jesus cautions against being well spoken of by all, likening it to the fate of false prophets. True wisdom and safety come from walking with the wise and trusting in the Lord rather than fearing man (Proverbs 13:20; 29:25). Genuine friendships require showing friendliness, but ultimate security is found not in human approval but in God’s favor. The pursuit of worldly gain, including popularity, is ultimately futile if it costs one's soul, as emphasized in Luke 9:25.
